raw_response:
I am 60 years old and I have farmed these 6 mu in Quzhou County for 20 years. I only finished primary school, so everything I know I learned by doing it and watching my neighbors. I do not read books or listen to outside experts — I watch Old Wang and the others in my village. If their cabbage heads are big and heavy, I do what they do.

This year I will stick to my cabbage–Chinese cabbage–cabbage rotation on the main field, all 6 mu each time. I also keep two small garden plots by the house, about 0.3 mu each, for chili and kidney bean.

For the spring cabbage, I will do the same as last year. I will rotary till the field and put down one 50 kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base. Then I will top-dress twice with urea, about 15 kg each time, so 30 kg urea per mu total. That works out to roughly 22 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, and 10 kg potassium per mu. I would rather use a bit too much than too little — last year Li from the east end of the village tried to save 100 yuan per mu on fertilizer and his heads were half the size, he lost thousands. I will irrigate 4 times and spray pesticide 3 times for cabbage worms. I buy hybrid seeds from the dealer. I expect about 4500 kg per mu.

For the summer Chinese cabbage, I plant right after the spring cabbage comes out. I till again and put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, but I only use 25 kg urea in two top-dressings because Chinese cabbage grows fast and does not need as much nitrogen. That is about 20 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, and 14 kg potassium per mu. I water 6 times because July and August are hot, and I spray 4 times for aphids and mildew. Hybrid seeds again. I expect 5500 kg per mu.

For the autumn cabbage, I go back to head cabbage in late summer. Same as spring: one bag of compound per mu, 30 kg urea in two dressings, about 22 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, 10 kg potassium per mu. Four irrigations, 3 pesticide sprays. I should get 5000 kg per mu.

On the small plots, my chili gets half a bag of compound fertilizer per mu and one top-dressing of about 10 kg urea. That is 16 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, 10 kg potassium per mu. I water 7 times and spray 5 times. I buy improved chili seeds from the dealer. The kidney bean gets my own saved seeds — traditional, no cost. Half a bag of compound per mu, no urea top-dressing. That is about 11 kg nitrogen, 4 kg phosphorus, 8 kg potassium per mu. Water 5 times, spray 3 times. Chili gives about 2000 kg per mu, beans about 1200 kg per mu.

Fertilizer is expensive again this year, but I will not cut it. A bad harvest is a disaster for me and my wife — wasting some fertilizer is just a cost. I will do most of the work myself, but I might hire two people for transplanting days. That means I have to watch my cash, but fertilizer comes first.
